notes.title: Realism Mode Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Changes:[/b]
• Added [b]Realism Mode[/b]: products now have expiration dates.
• Improved the [b]“Details” window[/b] in the [i]Incidents[/i] section to show more information.
• Reworked the [b]level-up balance[/b].
• The [b]first shop[/b] now unlocks at [b]level 5[/b] instead of 10.[/p]

notes.title: New App Release: Side Jobs – Start Earning with Nordwell
notes.content: [p]A new app called "Side Jobs" is available. [/p][p]There, you’ll be able to earn some extra cash with zero investment. When the update drops, there’ll be one side job available for Nordwell:[/p][p]• They’ll be using your warehouse for supplier transit. [/p][p]• Your job: follow storage conditions, be on time, and check the equipment.[/p]

notes.title: New Upgrades & Features
notes.content:
[p]• Truck upgrades have been moved out of the training system - now you can buy additional trucks   directly from the upgrades page.   [/p][p]• On that same page, new upgrades are available:                    [/p][p]          – Increase your cart size.                    [/p][p]          – Boost the number of delivery orders.  [/p][p]
• A store slot limit system has been added - now there’s a cap on how many stores you can open.   [/p][p]• But don’t worry, you can also buy extra store slots as an upgrade.[/p]

notes.title: Quality of Life and UI Improvements Patch
notes.content:
• Added product list filter: now you can sort by store type.
• New corner window showing current money and rating.
• Fixed fridge door hitbox - easier product placement.
• NumPad Enter now saves the result in the calculator.
• "Replay" button no longer appears after a flawless delivery.

notes.title: 4:3 Support & Storage Fix
notes.content:
Added support for 4:3 aspect ratio monitors
Fixed a bug where storage units disappeared after purchase

notes.title: Update: Hiring Fix, Numpad Support, New Warehouse Colors
notes.content: The bug with hiring employees for the warehouse was fixed, numpad input was added to the calculator, and several color options were added for the warehouse.

notes.title: Store Keeper - Release Day is Here!
notes.content:
[p][b]Pre-release Bug Hunt[/b][/p][p]As always, right before release, a few bugs and critical issues decided to show up in [i]Store Keeper[/i].
Big thanks to all the content creators who shared their experience and helped spot these problems.[/p][p][b]Here’s what’s been fixed:[/b]
• Fixed a critical bug that prevented you from exiting the warehouse editing window.
• Fixed a bug that broke the supply system if you quickly closed the error-check window after a delivery.
• Fixed an issue where signing the tax invoice was impossible, forcing a game restart.
• Fixed the company name change system — it should now work properly.
• Added animations to the buttons that open help prompts — a bit of extra polish.[/p]

notes.title: Store Keeper launches in less than a week!
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone who followed the development, helped out, made videos, and shared ideas. This wouldn't have been possible without you![/p]

notes.title: 400 Wishlists Reached! Thank You for Your Support!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]We’ve hit a big milestone - [b]400 wishlists[/b] on Steam! Huge thanks to everyone who added the game - your support means the world to us and keeps us moving forward.[/p][p]To celebrate, we’ve prepared a short [b]gameplay video[/b] to show how the project is coming along:
📺 Watch it here: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/KD-2gXmTjvg"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you haven’t added the game to your wishlist yet, now’s the perfect time![/p]

notes.title: Demo Version Improvements and Fixes
notes.content: You can now continue playing after finishing the demo, with limited content available. We've also made several improvements: localization issues have been fixed, some textures have been updated, a new tab has been added to track all warehouse items, and the tutorial has been made clearer. Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Update Based on Player Feedback
notes.content:
In this update, we've addressed your feedback to make the game more convenient and user-friendly:


You can now open the invoice with a single press of the Tab key - no more extra steps required.

Exiting the computer interface is now more intuitive - just press Esc.

Some products can now be moved more freely, allowing for more flexible management.

New tips have been added to help you navigate the game more easily.

Thank you for your feedback - it helps us make the game better!
